note: Actions taken from ANGRAU Regional Agricultural Research Station, Tirupati packages of practices. Water, labour and budget are left null because the sources do not state them per action. The source's own stage wording is kept in each description; mapping it to the app's six growth stages is noted there.

sources.RICE: ANGRAU RARS Tirupati, Recommendations for Rice Crop Production and Package of Practices, Kharif 2014 & Rabi 2014-15 (Southern Zone), https://www.rarstpt.org/files/rars/package%20of%20practices/Rice.pdf
sources.MAIZE: ANGRAU RARS Tirupati, Maize (Zea mays L.) Package of Practices (Kharif and Rabi), https://rarstpt.org/files/rars/package%20of%20practices/MaizePackage.pdf

actions.name: Transplant rice seedlings at recommended age and density
actions.description: Transplant 30-day-old seedlings in Kharif and 20-25-day-old seedlings in Rabi, 33 hills/m2 in Kharif and 44 hills/m2 in Rabi, 2-3 seedlings per hill at 2-3 cm depth. Avoid over-aged seedlings. (Source section: Main Field.)

actions.name: Keep shallow water at transplanting, then 5 cm until establishment
actions.description: Maintain 1-2 cm of water at transplanting and increase to 5 cm after transplanting until the crop is established. (Source section: Water Management.)

actions.name: Apply pre-emergence herbicide within 3-5 days of transplanting
actions.description: With a thin film of water, apply one of: Butachlor 1.25 l/acre, Anilophos 500 ml/acre, Pretilachlor 600 ml/acre or Oxadiargyl 40 g/acre within 3-5 days after transplanting. Keep the crop weed free till 45 DAT. (Source section: Weed Management.)

actions.name: Control gall midge with granules at 15 DAT
actions.description: Apply phorate 10G at 12.5 kg/ha or carbofuran 3G at 25 kg/ha at 15 days after transplanting in 1-2 inches of standing water, when gall midge reaches the ETL (one silver shoot per hill or 5% galls per sq m). (Source section: Chemical Control, Tillering Stage.)

actions.name: Top-dress nitrogen at active tillering
actions.description: Apply N in three equal splits (basal, active tillering, panicle initiation); P2O5 and K2O fully as basal. Recommended 80:60:40 kg/ha N:P2O5:K2O in Kharif and 120:60:40 in Rabi. Drain the field before top dressing and irrigate after 2 days. Source stage: active tillering. (Source section: Nutrient Management.)

actions.name: Maintain 2-3 cm water during tillering
actions.description: Maintain a shallow 2-3 cm depth of water during the tillering phase. (Source section: Water Management.)

actions.name: Hand weed at 20 and 40 days after transplanting
actions.description: Hand weed at 20 and 40 DAT where enough manual labour is available; for broadleaved weeds spray 2,4-D SS at 400 g/acre at 20-25 DAT. (Source section: Weed Management.)

actions.name: Spray against stem borer, thrips and hispa at tillering
actions.description: When ETL is reached (stem borer: one egg mass per sq m or 5% dead hearts), spray monocrotophos 36 SL 1.6 ml, chlorpyriphos 20 EC 2.5 ml or phosphamidon 40 SL 2.0 ml per litre of water. Source stage: tillering. (Source section: Chemical Control.)

actions.name: Spray for sheath blight at disease initiation
actions.description: At initiation of sheath blight (normally about 45 DAT in Kharif, 30 DAT in Rabi), spray hexaconazole 5EC 2 ml/l, validamycin 3L 2 ml/l or propiconazole 25 EC 1 ml/l; 2 sprays at 15-day interval. (Source section: Rice Diseases.)

actions.name: Maintain 5 cm water from panicle initiation; avoid stress at flowering
actions.description: Maintain 5 cm of water from panicle initiation to physiological maturity (until 10 days before harvest). The crop should not face water stress at panicle initiation, flowering and milk stages. (Source section: Water Management.)

actions.name: Top-dress final nitrogen split at panicle initiation
actions.description: Apply the third equal split of N at panicle initiation; in light-textured soils apply half the K2O here with this top dressing. Source stage: panicle initiation (mapped to Flowering). (Source section: Nutrient Management.)

actions.name: Spray against BPH/WBPH from panicle initiation to booting
actions.description: At ETL (20-25 insects per hill after flowering), spray e.g. acephate 1.5 g, imidacloprid 0.25 ml or buprofezin 1.6 ml per litre, 200 l/acre directed at the plant base. Do not mix insecticides with synthetic pyrethroids. (Source section: Panicle Initiation to Booting Stage.)

actions.name: Spray for neck blast before panicle emergence
actions.description: Under disease-favourable weather, spray tricyclazole 75 WP 0.6 g/l or isoprothiolane 40 EC 1.5 ml/l just before panicle emergence (one spray). (Source section: Rice Diseases.)

actions.name: Spray for false smut at flowering
actions.description: At flowering, one evening spray of propiconazole 25 EC 1.0 ml/l, copper oxychloride 50 WP 2.0 g/l or carbendazim 50 WP 1.0 g/l. (Source section: Rice Diseases.)

actions.name: Harvest at 80% grain maturity and dry to below 13% moisture
actions.description: Harvest when at least 80% of grains are mature, dry in the field for 2-3 days, thresh and winnow, then sun-dry grain to below 13% moisture. Avoid over- and under-drying. (Source section: Harvesting and Storage.)

actions.name: Thin to one seedling per hill 10 days after emergence
actions.description: Thin excess seedlings 10 days after emergence to keep a single seedling per hill, maintaining about 33,333 plants/acre at 60 x 20 cm. (Source sections: Method of sowing, Critical interventions.)

actions.name: Prophylactic spray against stem borer at 10-12 days
actions.description: Spray monocrotophos 36 SC 1.6 ml/l or Coragen 0.3 ml/l when the crop is 10-12 days old, and/or apply carbofuran 3G in leaf whorls at 3 kg/acre at 25-30 days. (Source section: Plant protection, Pests.)

actions.name: Apply pre-emergence atrazine
actions.description: Spray atrazine 50 WP at 800-1200 g/acre depending on soil type as pre-emergence (pure maize crop only). Keep the crop weed free up to 45 days. (Source section: Weeding.)

actions.name: Top-dress nitrogen at knee-high stage
actions.description: Apply the knee-high split of N (30-35 DAS). Kharif: 72-80 kg N per acre in three splits (sowing, knee high, flowering). Rabi: 80-100 kg N per acre in four splits. Time top dressing with rains in Kharif. (Source section: Fertilizers.)

actions.name: Control broadleaved weeds at 30 DAS, then intercultivate and earth up
actions.description: At 30 days after sowing spray 2,4-D sodium salt 80 WP at 500 g/acre in 200 litres of water; after 30-35 days intercultivate and earth up. (Source section: Weeding.)

actions.name: Spray mancozeb for leaf blight from knee-high stage
actions.description: One to two sprays of mancozeb 2.5 g/l at 7-10 day intervals starting from the knee-high stage control leaf blight. (Source section: Plant protection, Diseases.)

actions.name: Apply final nitrogen split at flowering / tasseling-silking
actions.description: Kharif: third N split at flowering. Rabi: fourth N split at tasseling-silking (60-65 DAS). (Source section: Fertilizers.)

actions.name: Irrigate at flowering and silking
actions.description: If drought occurs during flowering, irrigation helps give good yields; irrigation at silking is a critical intervention. In Rabi one of the 4-6 irrigations falls at flowering. (Source sections: Irrigation, Critical interventions.)

actions.name: Irrigate at milky and dough / early grain-filling stages
actions.description: Irrigate at milky and dough stages; in a six-irrigation Rabi schedule, two irrigations follow flowering and one is at early grain filling. Source stage: grain filling (mapped to Fruiting). (Source sections: Irrigation, Critical interventions.)
